scripts.name: Example - Scheduled alternating beeper
scripts.summary: This official BaudBound example script demonstrates how to alternate between two beeping sounds using the scheduler.

latest.release_notes: Initial release. This example runs once per second and uses a persistent Boolean variable to alternate between 400 Hz and 800 Hz beeps. It demonstrates scheduled triggers, conditional branches, persistent variables, and sound actions.
